title: Group R-1.
officialText:
Accessible units, Type B+NYC units, and Type B units shall be provided in Group R-1 occupancies in
accordance with Sections 1107.6.1.1 through 1107.6.1.3.
Exception: Boarding houses, dormitories, fraternity houses and sorority houses in Group R-1 occupancies shall comply with
Section 1107.6.1.4.
